messages:
erin: Follow-up from the postmortem  let's lock owners/backups and short timelines for span loss, bad aggregation, and ETL lag. I'll seed a short plan.

alex: I can own the span extractor backpressure. Quick mitigation = JVM bump + pin GC flags, full fix = backpressure tokens and safer batching.

maria: Aggregator double-count is from retries replaying the same batch. Plan = dedupe by (trace_id,span_id,batch_id) + metric `agg.dedupe.hits`. PR incoming.

sam: ETL lag was a partition rollout + broker stall. Reverted rollout earlier, adding `etl.lag_95` alert and emergency reassign runbook.

erin: Proposed owners/timelines: A) span extractor mitigation -> alex -> staging EOD, canary 24h, full fix by 2026-04-12; B) aggregator dedupe -> maria -> PR by 2026-03-31, canary 2026-04-04; C) ETL stability -> sam -> tune in 48h.

noah: I'll be backup for alex while he's on PTO next week.

alex: Deploying JVM bump to staging now. infra-bot will log it.

infra-bot: deploy started by alex at 1841234605  span-extractor/jvm-bump -> staging

alex: Staging signals: consumer lag down ~30%, GC tail reduced. Monitoring `span.kv.misses` and `gc.pause_ms`.

maria: PR will add `agg.dedupe.replays` and `agg.dedupe.hits` and unit tests for idempotent increments. Also adding a small sliding cache for dedupe.

erin: Two systemic items: 1) chaos regression to simulate short GC pauses and assert no span loss -> owner: maria -> ETA 2w; 2) weekly observability digest tile for `agg.dedupe.hits`, `span.kv.misses`, `etl.lag_95` -> owner: erin -> ETA 1w.

sam: Added runbook step and dashboard tile for partition idle seconds. Logs/snippets linked in postmortem doc.

erin: I'll write a short customer blurb for support: "We've mitigated the issues causing missing spans and aggregation drift. Engineers deployed mitigations and are rolling fixes; metrics should normalize within 48 hours." Approve?

maria: LGTM.

alex: Agreed. Daily 15m check-ins at 09:15 PST for the next 3 days. If anyone is blocked DM me. :thumbsup:
